story_type: security camera catches a tornado strike
hook: A security camera was rolling when the tornado hit.
narration: This security camera at a lock in Chattanooga was rolling when a tornado touched down.
It was about a quarter to six on an October evening at Chickamauga Lock.
Watch the left side of the frame. The rain starts moving sideways.
Then the wind tore two maintenance trailers apart.
Even a weak tornado brings winds over sixty five miles an hour, enough to roll a trailer that is not tied down.
[short pause] Those bright flashes came as the storm tore into the electrical systems.
The camera kept recording as the storm swept across the lock.
outcome: The tornado destroyed two maintenance trailers and damaged a government vehicle and the office roof.
title: Security camera caught a tornado hit
description:
A tornado touched down at the Army Corps of Engineers' Chickamauga Lock in Chattanooga, Tennessee, on Oct. 26, 2010, and the lock's security camera recorded it.

Footage: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Nashville District security system video, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/99036/tornado-scores-touch-down-chickamauga-lock
